title: kramastotra — kram-p09-v09
question: Thus in such forms, giver, varied indeed Your form shines — in own portion, in this world, difference gone, of the Lord. To praise that same, may heart, and songs of outer speech-instruments, be mine constantly, in unabandoned rush.
